blocks.text: Luningning, best known for her stint as a dancer on the now-defunct variety show “Wowowee,” celebrated her first pregnancy at 43 years old, describing it as the “most beautiful miracle” she has received. The dancer, whose real name is Lea Carla Gonzaga, marked her birthday by showing snaps from her maternity shoot, through her Instagram page on Sunday, Nov. 8. “At 43, life has given me the most beautiful miracle — the blessing of becoming a mom for the first time.
